issues.explanation: Entity.php:19 and EntityMembership.php:80 use #[HasFactory] as an attribute instead of the use HasFactory trait so Entity::factory() and EntityMembership::factory() cannot work.
Both policies import Illuminate\Contracts\Auth\HandlesAuthorization which does not exist instead of Illuminate\Auth\Access\HandlesAuthorization so the policy classes fail to load.
The diff adds no tests/ files for entities, memberships, roles, or policies despite the TDD convention requiring tests for every feature including authorization paths.
UserFactory.php deletes the unverified() state, remember_token field, and cached Hash::make password pattern even though the task does not ask to change user accounts.
EntityFactory.php:386 builds slug via Str::slug($name) without unique() so slug collisions can violate the entities_slug_unique contract despite unique company names.
The one-owner guarantee relies on two raw DB::statement calls with fixed INTEGER plus GENERATED ALWAYS AS syntax whose portability to MariaDB is unverified from the diff alone.
Entity.php imports Builder and Arr, User.php imports UserRole, and EntityMembership.php imports unused models without using them.
AuthServiceProvider.php:349 maps policies with plain strings instead of ::class constants and adds a provider file that modern Laravel auto-discovery makes unnecessary.

conventions.evidence: No tests/ files in change.diff violates TDD no production code without a test; docs/database-schema.md:565,574 correctly updated but UserFactory.php:440 deletes unverified()/remember_token and both policies use wrong HandlesAuthorization namespace

readability.evidence: Methods are small with clear names such as membershipFor and manageSettings but unused imports in Entity.php:16-17 and attribute misuse #[HasFactory] at Entity.php:19 hurt maintainability

requirements.evidence: Migrations cover entities_slug_unique and entity_memberships_entity_user_unique plus owner_seq logic and policies match task rules, but #[HasFactory] misuse at app/Models/Entity.php:19, wrong HandlesAuthorization at app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:17, and non-unique slug at database/factories/EntityFactory.php:386 break the contract

scope.evidence: Models, migrations, policies, factories, and docs/database-schema.md serve the task, but database/factories/UserFactory.php:440 rewrites password handling and deletes unverified() as an unrelated breaking edit

security.evidence: EntityPolicy.php:295-328 and EntityMembershipPolicy.php:226-261 correctly enforce member-view, owner/admin-update, owner-only-manageSettings, and never-delete-owner plus self-removal with no unescaped output or Livewire surface

simplicity.evidence: Models, enum, policies, and migrations are direct with no speculative layers, apart from an arguably unnecessary AuthServiceProvider and unused imports

tests.evidence: change.diff contains zero new tests/ paths and therefore no coverage of creation, single-owner rejection, scopes, factories, or unauthorized-call paths

review.summary: The change implements the entities and memberships schema, models, enum, factories, policies, and schema-doc update with correct authorization logic, but it cannot be approved because factories and policies use wrong APIs, it ships no tests, and it regresses UserFactory.
